relationships.evidence_quote: confirmed a positive correlation between the expression of FOXA2 and CPT1A

relationships.subject: FOXA2
relationships.evidence_quote: mice overexpressing spinal FOXA2 (SNI + AAV-Foxa2+) exhibited significantly reduced ipsilateral mechanical and cold pain sensitivity

relationships.subject: FOXA2
relationships.evidence_quote: SNI injury triggered both microglial activation and concomitant LDs accumulation in the SDH, effects that were significantly mitigated by FOXA2 overexpression

relationships.subject: FOXA2
relationships.evidence_quote: Restoration of FOXA2 expression rescues abnormal phagocytic activity in SDH microglia and helps rebalance the ratio of excitatory to inhibitory synapses.

relationships.subject: FOXA2
relationships.evidence_quote: the levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines IL-1β, TNF-α, and iNOS were significantly increased in the spinal cords of SNI + AAV-NC and Sham + AAV-Foxa2⁻ mice

relationships.subject: RGFP966
relationships.evidence_quote: Pharmacological inhibition of HDAC3 by RGFP966 significantly enhanced FOXA2 binding to the CPT1A promoter region

relationships.subject: HDAC3
relationships.evidence_quote: We identified HDAC3-mediated deacetylation as a critical regulatory mechanism controlling FOXA2 transcriptional activity.

key_findings: FOXA2 is downregulated in spinal microglia after SNI; its overexpression upregulates CPT1A, restores microglial lipid metabolism and synaptic pruning, and relieves neuropathic pain.
HDAC3 deacetylation restrains FOXA2; RGFP966 enhances FOXA2 binding to the CPT1A promoter.
